description.zh: 零代码拖拽配置，实时可视化呈现辖区治安态势与警力分布，赋能指挥决策。
description.en: No-code drag-and-drop dashboards showing live jurisdiction safety and force distribution for command decisions.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我大屏要展示的指标与布局，我来生成数据大屏
welcome_message.en: Tell me the metrics and layout — I'll build the data screen

description.zh: 输入：辖区指标数据或上传 CSV，说明治安态势与警力分布的展示维度。预期产物：outbound/<task>/ 下的 dashboard.html、chart-config.json 与 query.sql
description.en: Input: jurisdiction metrics or CSV, plus display dimensions for safety and force distribution. Output: dashboard.html, chart-config.json and query.sql under outbound/<task>/

prompt.zh:
请生成警务数据大屏页面。

数据（粘贴表格或说明文件名）：

展示维度（辖区治安态势、警力分布、重点指标）：

预期产物：在 outbound/<task>/ 下生成 dashboard.html（大屏风格自包含页面，含图表）、chart-config.json（图表配置）和 query.sql（查询语句）。没有真实数据库时只使用我提供的数据或明确标注的演示样例。
prompt.en:
Please build a policing data screen.

Data (paste table or file name):

Dimensions (jurisdiction safety, force distribution, key metrics):

Expected output: dashboard.html (self-contained big-screen page with charts), chart-config.json and query.sql under outbound/<task>/. Without a real database, use only my data or clearly labeled demo samples.
